description: HaitiBRD: A labeled satellite imagery dataset for building and road damage assessment of the 2010 Haiti earthquake is published by Lin, Szu-Yun; Edocia, Marisa; Tsai, Fang Jung; Chen, Lien an; Kuo, Wen-Ni. It describes paired 0.5 m satellite images and building and road damage labels around Port-au-Prince after the 2010 earthquake. Coverage is regional within HT. Spatial detail: 0.5 m imagery; approximately 3.51 km² study extent. Temporal coverage: Images acquired 9 and 15 January 2010. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. Data format is not established in the metadata reviewed. Licence: Open Data Commons Attribution in deposit metadata; source imagery described as CC-BY-NC-4.0. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. The deposit-level and source-imagery terms differ. Preserve both; do not imply unrestricted commercial use of all files. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits.
